newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.166pts to 102.522.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.166pts to 102.522.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds lost 0.166 points in Friday's trading to 102.522, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio rose by 0.104 points to 2.626 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, lost 0.053 points to 99.160, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.487 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 5.032 points to 1,059.390.
